originality.rationale: The 2019 general bilateral shift theorem already supplies the qualitative shadowability classification, but not the sharp least correction norm nor the simultaneous-tail lower witness or exponent profile. Those quantitative elements are proved explicitly here. Full-text priority comparison with the 2026 Pinto preprint was not possible; this is a recorded residual risk, not evidence of uniqueness.

No claim that the earlier qualitative or nonhyperbolic examples themselves are new.
